def transform(grid):
    # Transpose the seed, then reflect it across each tile boundary to make
    # a 3-by-3 kaleidoscopic tiling (horizontal/vertical/horizontal).
    a = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)]
    h = [row[::-1] for row in a]
    v = a[::-1]
    hv = [row[::-1] for row in v]
    tiles = [[a, h, a], [v, hv, v], [a, h, a]]
    return [sum((tiles[tr][tc][r] for tc in range(3)), [])
            for tr in range(3) for r in range(len(a))]
PY
